description: Given CHK-1, when test-estimates.sh runs every case once, then each of the 29 cases the old rows named passes: area, size, similar goals, monotone growth and range text; pace, overrun and off-flow steps; big goals, cache and worktree; backtest scores, accuracy line, stall and held time; backtest speed and recompute.

Given a running goal and goal.py, when test-goal.sh runs its 4 cases, then each passes: a changed done line stops the goal; the Delivery page names every goal.py command and flag; a refused first push is retried and the second opens the pull request; a final failure prints git's own error.

Given HLT-2, when test-health-hygiene.sh runs its 12 cases, then each passes: every rule's negative control fires and a broken rule is reported as unable to fire; a rule without a control is refused; test time, worktree and branch rules warn, stay quiet and are never filed; health removes nothing itself.

Given MCH-1, when test-machine.sh runs every case once, then each of the 12 cases the old rows named passes: apply installs the skills, hooks and mailer and a dry run writes nothing; the check names each gap; the guide, New machine steps and rows are listed; one staggered task per repo; custom items, mailer, caps, peer, backup and restore.

Given DOC-25, when test-docs-format.sh runs its 13 cases, then each passes: the DOC-4 Home, DOC-7 requirement and group, DOC-8 Problem, DOC-9 Tests table and DOC-1 cap checks fail naming the page and rule; the format key turns Problem off; the guide marker is refused; Home links the How-to-use page.

Given DEL-17, when test-hard-eta.py runs its 10 cases, then each passes: a frozen goal holds a hard ETA, a step past it is refused and the goal waits with ship now, extend and defer; extending needs a record; health warns on eta-missing and fails on eta-extended and eta-overrun, each with a negative control; goal.py pr joins the queue.

Given REG-4, when test-criteria.sh runs its 5 cases, then each passes: a test with no criterion fails; a run records each test's status and date; a Tests row carries the test link, its Given/When/Then words and result; the full Tests page carries anchor, result, date, run and seen failing; cut refuses a missing row.

Given REG-4, when test-tiers.sh runs its 7 cases, then each passes: an unmapped or deleted change plans only affected rows at qa and pr; no merge-base is full; a record on the same merge-base is reused; the LANE line carries its ROWS summary; run --kind filters rows; a goal lane selects the nightly rows a change reaches.

Given REG-4, when test-lanes.sh runs its 7 cases, then each passes: unchanged content reuses every row; only the rows a change reaches run; a failing or missing record means a full run; ship reuses the qa run and the recorder gets the exact lane command; pr merges the base and reruns only the row the merge affected.

Given MCH-1, when test-budget.sh runs its 9 cases, then each passes: a step budget under 15 is refused with a fix line; rows run until the budget and the rest are left and listed; a review stopped at its limit records done with what it left; the run file, instructions, overrun record, report and health name the step and what it left.

Given CHK-1, when test-roadmap.py runs its 10 cases, then each passes: a closed hand row drops; status reads in flight, queued and open; Backlog and To-do issues are listed apart; each Priority cell is empty; a finished goal is not queued; no home path reaches the page; odd input never ends in a traceback.

Given REG-4, when test-narrow.sh runs its 9 cases, then each passes: a change to a declared file reruns only the rows whose closure reaches it; glob, folder and undeclared reads are refused; deleted files select the rows that name them, never a full run; no headers keep the wide mapping; lanes_cli.py check names code, file, line and fix.

Given DEL-1, when test-release-gate.py runs every leg once, then each passes: a major is refused naming the open issue, row, check or freeze; promote tags vX.0.0, keeps release/vX and moves main; revert opens a pull request back to the snapshot; a worker or a record naming another version is refused; the gate CI suite passes.

Given MCH-1, when test-budget-enforce.py runs its 12 cases, then each passes: a goal past its time or token budget is refused naming goal.py set; unknown tokens read unread; the 9th merge round waits for the owner; watch starts nothing past max_active_goals, plan_pause_percent or min_free_memory_gb; health warns; the settings table lists the four limits.
